I’m so tired all the time. I sleep eight hours, sometimes nap, but I still drag through the day. Getting out of bed feels like work, and keeping up with lectures or readings just wears me out. I used to care about doing well—I came to college wanting to study psychology, help people—but now I just show up, do the bare minimum. I keep thinking, *What’s the point? It’s not like I’m suicidal or anything, but I feel stuck. I try to study, I make plans, but it all feels pointless. Even when things go okay, I don’t feel proud—just empty. I’ve missed group meetings, skipped meals, fallen behind. I know I should reach out, but I just… don’t. It’s been like this since I was 17.
